$comment: Canonical PrivateFPC deployment descriptor — mirrors ecosystem-tooling's canonical-deployment.json at tag v5.0.0 (the publisher of @alejoamiras/aztec-fee-payment), extended with the installed artifact's digest. The address is derived from compiled bytecode + salt and is ONLY valid for this exact aztecVersion + artifact — depositing Fee Juice to a stale address is UNRECOVERABLE. The canonical salt is a fixed project constant from 5.0.0 onward; rc-era pins used operator-local salts and are dead. Machine-asserted by private-fuel.test.ts (derivation + digest) and consumed by check-fpc-version.ts (exact-version + digest + live-class gate).
